name: Piedrahita de Castro (Spain)
description: Divided by a green diagonal band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and red below, charged at the upper hoist with the crowned arms of Piedrahíta de Castro.
history: The arms and municipal flag were approved by the full council of Piedrahíta de Castro in its session of 26 April 2022; the flag is a rectangular cloth whose length is one and a half times its height.
